title: Count a pane whose shell failed to spawn as ended, not working
notes: pane-shells.ts:90-96: the in-process spawn catch (a stale SHELL_COMMAND) sends pty:exit 127 without calling main.ended, so releaseAgentPane never runs and mainsWorkers keeps the pane. The foot then says '1 worker: 1 working' over a pane showing exit 127 until the worker is released by hand. Fix: call main.ended(id, 127) in that catch. Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/397 Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/396#discussion_r4707963204

comments.body: Pull request #413 opened: End a pane whose shell failed to spawn, so its worker is released https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/413

Review loop converged in 2 rounds, ready to merge. Round 1: 2 threads, both fixed in b1380c49, which narrows the fix: only an agent pane whose shell failed to spawn calls main.ended. Ending a screen's plain shell, which spawns after main claims the worker, dropped the worker before its done report arrived. Round 2 re-review: nothing open. CI passed on the head commit. Step 1 printed 'was ready'.
